Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly prioritized Niyoti’s “official worldwide release” date (24 June 2016) over its earlier actual theatrical release in India (10 June 2016), then compared that to Angali Pangali’s 17 June 2016 date. Since “came out earlier” should use the earliest public release, Niyoti (10 June 2016) precedes Angali Pangali (17 June 2016). This misinterpretation led to the wrong final conclusion.
